name: PowOS boot hook
purpose: Magisk's boot script: mounts PowOS's root, DNS, x86 binfmt, sshd, the port lock (iptables chain powos-local), the system tier and the app-data watcher - at every boot

commands: for p in 3410; do while iptables -w -D OUTPUT -o lo -p tcp --dport $p -j powos-local 2>/dev/null; do :; done; done; iptables -w -F powos-local; iptables -w -X powos-local
